what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a contractor yard special permit for a Mass Ave commercial development, with conditions, after neighbors objected; the roll call was only partly captioned.
The conditions include a buffer and sound barrier to the north and east, privacy fencing at storage areas, no outdoor equipment repair, no hazardous materials, and no work from 11pm to 4am.
The board also voted on a dimensional variation for natural vegetation disturbance at 1325 Mass Ave; the vote was not audible in the captions.
The board voted on a special permit to build a new three-bedroom home on a nonconforming lot at 451 Townsend Harbor Road; the vote was not audible.
The board noted the Mass Ave applicant must still return for planning board site plan review and possibly Conservation Commission review.

why_it_matters: The Mass Ave permit sets the operating limits for a contractor yard near homes and schools, where neighbors raised noise, lighting and truck traffic.
The conditions are the enforceable part of the approval, and the planning board and possibly the Conservation Commission can still shape or change the project.
